network_WiFi_APSupportedRates: improve DUT-transmission filters {Broad,multi}cast frames may get re-transmitted back at the DUT, using its own SA (but not TA). These are not under the DUT's control and should not penalize the DUT, if they happen to be at a lower rate. Similarly, some Ack or BlockAck frames are getting transmitted at lower rates, but that only appears to be because the frame to which the DUT is replying (i.e., the AP's frames) are transmitted at those rates. Also avoid penalizing the DUT for simply Ack'ing at the same rate. We probably could fix these sorts of problems within the AP, but that's less important to us than getting the DUT behavior correct. BUG=none TEST=run it Change-Id: I27d1cbf8ebdf13a0e55c29cead6b42df1c7bacb0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1679995 Tested-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Neeraj Poojary <npoojary@chromium.org>

Regenerate the mock owner public key and metric_{on,off} policies At some point, the acceptable format for the owner key changed, in terms of header sizes. This can be seen in commit d29ae33459d4 ("Updated policy_testserver to support verification key signatures"), in the chrome repo. Unfortunately, the code in this directory was not updated. As a result, if a user had logged into a test machine at any point before running platform_KernelErrorPaths (i.e. the machine has an owner), the test machine gets powerwashed and the test fails. The original code for generating the public key and the policy blobs is found attached to this document: https://sites.google.com/a/google.com/chromeos/archive/testing-tools-for-device-policies Along with it are the instructions to generate the keys. We follow these instructions and commit the updated code. TEST=platform_KernelErrorPaths.BUG passes after this. Tried running platform_KernelErrorPaths.ALL, but it has other issues. BUG=chromium:966593 Change-Id: Id05e869bcb375e4a85a4f25949d462bcd7765959 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1653840 Tested-by: Salman Qazi <sqazi@google.com> Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Jorge Lucangeli Obes <jorgelo@chromium.org>
